utterances.speaker: JUDGE SHAHABUDDEEN
utterances.text: Madam Registrar, will you please call the case.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. This is IT-98-32-A, the Prosecutor versus Mitar Vasiljevic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE SHAHABUDDEEN
utterances.text: May we have the appearances. Counsel for the appellant identify himself.

utterances.speaker: MR. DOMAZET
utterances.text: Yes, Your Honour, Vladimir Domazet, the lead counsel for Mitar Vasiljevic, and Mr. Bosko Ristic, my legal advisor in the defence team.

utterances.speaker: MR. DOMAZET
utterances.text: Thank you. Counsel for the Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: MR. STAKER
utterances.text: May it please Your Honour, my name is Christopher Staker. I appear with my colleague, Mr. Steffan Wirth. Our case manager is Ms. Lourdes Galicia.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE SHAHABUDDEEN
utterances.text: May I turn to the accused, the appellant, to make sure that he is hearing me in a language which he understands. THE APPELLANT: [No Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: JUDGE SHAHABUDDEEN
utterances.text: Thank you. Please be seated. Now, this meeting of the Appeals Chamber is held pursuant to a conference -- Status Conference order made on 17th of March, 2003. Mr. Vasiljevic, I understand that the case against you was concluded on the 29th of November, 2002, and that you filed a notice of appeal on 30 December, 2002. There were certain proceedings on that notice of appeal, and you then filed an amended notice of appeal on 12th of February, 2003. So your status at this moment is that you are an appellant, and that being so, I would read to you the applicable rule. It is Rule 65 bis (B) with which all counsel would be familiar, but I do feel there is virtue in reading it out to you. It says: "The Appeals Chamber or an Appeals Chamber Judge shall convene a Status Conference within 120 days of the filing of a notice of appeal, and thereafter within 120 days after the last Status Conference to allow any person in custody pending appeal the opportunity to raise issues in relation thereto including the mental and physical condition of that person." Now, this is the first such conference, and I may recap by summarising the ideas which proceed from this rule. They are, first, to afford you an opportunity to mention any concerns you have about the condition of your detention, et cetera, and to update you on the status of your appeal. I think it's a very valuable rule, and it gives to you and to any appellants in your condition an opportunity to maintain a living connection with the judicial branch of the Tribunal. So now would you like to avail yourself of this opportunity to state whether you are satisfied with the conditions of your detention, whether you have any problems or so? THE APPELLANT: [Interpretation] Your Honour, I am satisfied with the conditions in the Detention Unit, and I have no problems whatsoever. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE SHAHABUDDEEN
utterances.text: Thank you. Would your counsel wish to add anything to that?

utterances.speaker: MR. DOMAZET
utterances.text: No, Your Honour, we will not.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE SHAHABUDDEEN
utterances.text: Now, may I then turn to the status of your appeal. I have recited certain facts a while ago. And the position is that by an order the 29th of January this year, the Appeals Chamber speaking through myself said to you that you were to file your appellant's brief not later than 40 days after the date of filing of the B/C/S translation of the Trial Chamber's judgement. Now, I have to tell you that I'm informed reliably that the B/C/S version of the judgement would be filed today so that you would then have in accordance with this order until the 10th of June to file your appellant's brief, and thereafter the proceedings will continue in conformity with the procedures set out in the rules. Is that clear? Counsel, is that clear?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE SHAHABUDDEEN
utterances.text: Has the Prosecution got any comment?

utterances.speaker: MR. STAKER
utterances.text: No, Your Honour. We have no comment.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE SHAHABUDDEEN
utterances.text: If there is nothing more to be said, I would adjourn these proceedings until the next Status Conference takes place. Thank you very much.
